Why We Exist

The future of healthcare will happen in the home. Home care providers today are drowning in chaos - spreadsheets, late-night calls, missed visits, caregivers churning at 80% a year. If no one fixes this, our parents will suffer and their children will burn out.

Zingage is building the infrastructure so our parents can age with dignity, and their children can live without sacrificing everything. Every line of code here serves that mission. Learn more about out vision on: https://ArmTheHomeFront.com.

Who We Are

We are Francis Drake — pirates with responsibility. We move fast, bend convention, and take risks others won’t.

We’ve already lived this problem: we went door to door with boxes of donuts to win our first customers. We literally sat inside agencies and became schedulers ourselves to feel the pain. At our first conference, we hired an actress off Craigslist to hustle leads — $200K in pipeline came out of it. We won our biggest partnership by sneaking into a WellSky user conference posing as customers, then backing it up with an SDK that outpaced every competitor.

That’s who we are: scrappy enough to break through, serious enough to stand behind what we ship.

About the Role

We already power hundreds of healthcare sites and coordinate thousands of caregiver visits every week. Our system ingests breakdowns in real time — missed visits, caregiver no-shows, last-minute call-offs — and drives resolution loops with AI + human operators. The stakes are real: if our system fails, patients go without care.

As an early-career engineer, you’ll work directly on these systems. This is not a training program — you’ll be writing code that reaches caregivers and patients within weeks of joining. You’ll be learning side by side with founding engineers who previously built at Uber, Datadog, Ramp, and Tennr — and who are now applying that experience to one of the most important problems in healthcare.

What You’ll Do

Build AI agents that resolve care incidents — from missed clock-ins to caregiver no-shows — efficiently and accurately.

Work on voice AI where failure isn’t cosmetic: if it breaks, someone’s parent could be left alone.

Engineer deep EMR integrations (WellSky, AxisCare, AlayaCare), solving problems in data integrity, indexing, and real-time search.

Build closed-loop human + AI systems where operators and models collaborate to keep care running.

Ship into production fast, with stakes and leverage most engineers never see this early in their career.

Who You Are

You’ve hacked projects from 0→1 — a weird app, a robot, a compiler, whatever — because you couldn’t not build.

You get excited by multi-agent systems, coordination under uncertainty, or voice AI where failure has real stakes.

You’ve gone deep on something unusual (research, side project, hobby) and obsessed until it worked.

You care about what happens if no one fixes home care — the weight of real impact motivates you.

Why Zingage

Mission with weight. Every line of code you ship affects whether someone’s parent gets care.

Ownership from day one. You’ll work on core product — no training wheels.

Velocity. You’ll learn in months what would take years at a big company.

Trajectory. Backed by Bessemer and Ramp's Founder, scaling fast, defining the next decade of care.

Founder launchpad. When you’re ready to start your own company, we’ll invest up to $50K to help you launch.
